lead.notes: Firm is listed as a partner on thev.pt. David Sinclair trained at RIBA London; co-founded St George e Sinclair with Alan St George; practice passed to his own name in 1991 as David Sinclair Arquitectos. Notable past projects include Victoria Residences and As Cascatas Hilton Hotel (both Vilamoura, with WATG and John Seifert), Pestana Group projects, Pousadas in Porto/Lisbon/Madeira. The V is not listed or confirmed on the dsaa.pt portfolio pages accessible; rehabilitation projects listed on site are all outside Algarve residential context. Copyright on dsaa.pt footer: 2014. Role categorisation (lead/concept vs. local executive) is not specified on the official The V site.

local.notes: MAE lists 'The V' under its Construction category among 33 projects. Firm full name: Marques Antunes Engenharia, Lda. Based in Lagos, Portugal. Founded: August 13, 2015 (per third-party registry). CAE: civil construction, public works, real estate promotion, civil engineering, specialised construction. Role on The V website listed as a partner alongside architect and other firms — role described on thev.pt as partner, not specifically 'local architect'; firm is an engineering/construction entity not an architecture studio. Past projects include Casa das Freiras, Palmares Signature Villa, Villa Palmares, Casa Lioz, Villa Pernoi, Casa Sofia, Casa da Ria (with Mário Martins Atelier). The role listed as partner by the developer likely covers construction management/engineering.

landscape.notes: Jardim Vista is listed as a partner on thev.pt. Firm founded 1990 in the Algarve by Richard Westcott (BSc Horticulture & Landscape Design, Reading University, UK); described as largest landscaping company in the Iberian Peninsula; HQ in Almancil; operations across Portugal, Europe, Middle East, Africa; 250+ team members; eco-friendly/dry garden specialist. The V is not confirmed on the Jardim Vista website in accessible content. Algarve-based proximity confirmed.

interiors.notes: Pure Allure Interior is listed as a partner on thev.pt for 'tailored interior packages.' Founded by Esther and Patrick; tagline '25 Years of Timeless Interiors'; based in Algarve (Quinta do Lago, Vale do Lobo, Almancil area); official Flexform dealer for Algarve Portugal; exclusive Casamilano dealer in Portugal. The V is referenced on their website under 'Upcoming Projects' navigation item. Role is described as partnership for interior packages — not as sole interior designers of the development. Edwin Loxley supplies bespoke kitchen cabinetry separately (Edwin Loxley also operates as Loxley Kitchens Algarve based in Terras Ruivas, Portugal).
